{{nihongo|'''Shibukawa Shrine'''|渋川神社 (八尾市)}} is a shrine in Uematsu-chō, {{ill|Yao, Osaka|ar|ياو (أوساكا)|bcl|Yao, Osaka|be|Яо|bg|Яо|ca|Yao (Osaka)|ce|Яо (Осака)|ceb|Yao-shi|de|Yao (Osaka)|eo|Jao|es|Yao (Osaka)|et|Yao|fa|یائو، اوساکا|fi|Yao|fr|Yao (Osaka)|ga|Yao|gl|Yao|hy|Յաո|id|Yao, Osaka|it|Yao (Osaka)|ja|八尾市|ko|야오시|ms|Yao, Osaka|mzn|یائو، اوساکا|nl|Yao (Osaka)|no|Yao (Osaka)|pl|Yao (miasto)|pt|Yao (Osaka)|ro|Yao (municipiu)|ru|Яо (Япония)|sco|Yao, Osaka|sh|Yao, Osaka|simple|Yao, Osaka|sr|Јао|sv|Yao, Osaka|tg|Яо|th|ยาโอะ|tl|Yao, Osaka|tr|Yao, Osaka|tt|Яо (Осака)|uk|Яо (Осака)|ur|یاو، اوساکا|vi|Yao, Ōsaka|war|Yao, Osaka|zh|八尾市|zh_classical|八尾市|zh_min_nan|Yao-chhī|zh_yue|八尾|qid=Q490872}}, {{ill|Osaka Prefecture|Q122723|qid=Q122723}}. It is a {{ill|Shikinaisha|lt=Shikinaisha|qid=Q134917286}}, and under the {{ill|Modern system of ranked Shinto shrines|Q712534|Modern system of ranked Shinto shrines}} its former rank was {{ill|Gō-sha|Q134917316|qid=Q134917316}}. {{nihongo|'''Shibukawa Shrine'''|渋川神社 (八尾市)}} is a [[shinto shrine]] in the [[Engishiki Jinmyōchō]]. It is located in [[Kawachi Province]].

== History ==
* Enshrined deities are {{ill|Ame-no-oshihomimi|Q462555|qid=Q462555|lt=Ame-no-Oshihomimi-no-Mikoto}}, {{ill|Nigihayahi|Q10949054|qid=Q10949054|lt=Nigihayahi-no-Mikoto}}, Kunisatsuchi-no-Mikoto, Hidaka Ōkami, and Sugawara Ōkami.
* The date of foundation is unknown. It is also said to be the site of the Shibukawa residence of {{ill|Mononobe no Moriya|Q2424736|qid=Q2424736}}, whose base was in this area in the Asuka period.
* Originally it stood at Aza Kawamukai east of the old {{ill|Yamato River|Q9001527|qid=Q9001527}}, but a great flood in Tenbun 3 ({{ill|1533|Q6443|qid=Q6443}}) washed away the entire precinct. At that time, Ukishima Shrine drifted to Nitta Village in Matta District, several kilometers north. Later, in Genki 2 ({{ill|1572|Q6670|qid=Q6670}}), it was rebuilt at the current site, where the otabisho had been.
* In the precinct stand several large trees, including the Osaka Prefecture natural monument {{ill|Camphora officinarum|Q158722|qid=Q158722}}.

== Festivals ==
* Summer festival (July 25-26): commonly called the “reverse festival.” When the shrine was swept away by flood in the past, the sacred object reportedly flowed upstream against the current, giving rise to the name.

== Access ==
* About 5 minutes on foot from {{ill|Yao Station|Q856485|qid=Q856485}} on JR {{ill|Yamatoji Line|Q1151659|qid=Q1151659}}. It is located just south of the station.
